transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started with the daily programming review. Before we lock the program, I need to hear from rights clearance and submissions staff — are there any outstanding issues we should be aware of, particularly regarding any of the competition titles? I'd rather catch problems now than after the program goes public.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a rights clearance issue with 'After the Floodlights.' I reviewed the executed music and archive license this morning, and there are important restrictions: the festival may hold exactly one in-person public screening, may not publish any trailer or excerpt online, and must use the exact credit 'Courtesy of Northline Archive.' I haven't added the license summary to the programming file yet because the signed copy arrived in my separate clearance inbox, but the restrictions are confirmed.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a premiere status issue with 'After the Floodlights.' I checked the filmmaker's signed premiere declaration against the festival database today and confirmed that the film already had a public screening at the Harbor Documentary Week. This means it fails the competition's unpublished-premiere requirement. It must instead be offered, if retained, as a single special screening rather than as a competition title. I haven't updated the submission record yet because the database correction queue is still open, but the premiere status is confirmed.
transcript.speaker: A3

commitments.detail: Remove 'After the Floodlights' from competition titles and reclassify as a single special screening.
Limit to exactly one in-person public screening per the rights clearance restrictions.
Do not publish any trailer or excerpt online; remove any planned online trailer from the program.
Ensure the exact credit 'Courtesy of Northline Archive' is used in all materials.
Add the executed license summary to the programming file so the restrictions are formally documented.
Update the submission record to reflect the confirmed prior public screening at Harbor Documentary Week and the corrected premiere status.
